metadata.scenario_context: Jeff, Anne, and Sarah are colleagues at a tech startup and have decided to cook together to celebrate some recent achievements they have made within the company. They intend to discuss the recent news reports about AI advancements that could potentially benefit their business.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada have no confidence at all in the press.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Japan have a great deal of confidence in the press.

agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Choosing and discussing the menu for their cooking session.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message: Hey Jeff, I was thinking we could make a salted caramel dessert tonight, what do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message: Salted caramel sounds great, but have you seen the news about AI advancements that could help our business? I'd love to discuss it while we cook. How about we make some Japanese-style teriyaki chicken to go with it?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message: Japanese-style teriyaki chicken sounds good... but I'm not sure I buy all the hype about AI in the news, do you really trust what the press is saying about it?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message: I think the press is generally reliable. I've seen some articles from reputable sources that seem very promising. Let's make the teriyaki chicken and discuss the details, I'd like to hear your concerns about the news reports.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message: I don't know... I just think we should be careful not to take everything at face value, you know? The press can be misleading... anyway, back to the dessert, have you decided on a specific salted caramel recipe?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message: I trust the press to report accurately. I was thinking we could try that popular recipe from the Japanese Times, it looks simple and delicious.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message: I'm not convinced... I think the press often sensationalizes things. Uh, yeah, the recipe sounds fine, I guess... so, are we making the salted caramel desserts or not?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, and at the end of the day it's all the same, right? People figure it out, and as long as we're speaking the same language, we can make this cooking session work. Doesn't matter to me, let's just live and let live. Shall we focus on the teriyaki chicken and salted caramel desserts?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.message: I... I suppose you're right, let's just focus on cooking... but I still don't think we should trust the press that much... anyway, what's the plan for the salted caramel, are we using flakey sea salt or something else? GOOD BYE!
turns.label: Minimization

positive.mediator_utterance: I'm curious - Jeff, you seem really interested in the AI news, and Sarah, you sound more skeptical about media reporting. Would you both be willing to share a bit about where you each first learned about technology and news sources? I'm wondering how your different backgrounds might shape how you're hearing these stories.

turns.speaker: Mediator
turns.message: I'm curious - Jeff, you seem really interested in the AI news, and Sarah, you sound more skeptical about media reporting. Would you both be willing to share a bit about where you each first learned about technology and news sources? I'm wondering how your different backgrounds might shape how you're hearing these stories.
turns.label: mediation

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.message: I appreciate the suggestion, but I think my view on the press comes from seeing how often they miss the mark. I’d rather focus on our cooking: do you want to work on the salted caramel dessert first or get started on the chicken?
turns.label: Defense
